title: 第二章 全是陷阱，根本不是劫掠
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

北境边军，人人都怕黑羯骑兵。

这帮草原蛮子从小在马背上长大，弓马娴熟、凶悍嗜血，常年南下烧杀劫掠。

他们不种地不屯田，靠劫掠边境为生，所过之处鸡犬不留、尸横遍野。

黑羯骑兵机动性极强，打得赢就冲阵屠杀，打不赢就骑马迂回放风筝，用弓箭活活耗死步兵。

连大雍正规军都经常吃大亏，更别说黑石戍堡这种没人管、没人疼的破烂边堡。

刚才苏烬和周疤子的私斗，在敌袭号角响起的瞬间，直接作废。

命都快没了，谁还敢窝里斗。

黑石戍堡编制五十人，官官相护、吃空饷，如今只剩二十三个老弱残兵。

要么年纪大、一身旧伤，要么就是新兵弱卒。

武器更是惨不忍睹。

刀是锈刀、矛是断矛，盾牌裂得不能再裂，还有好几个人手里就一根木棍，连铁家伙都摸不到。

就这配置，对上三十名全副武装、常年杀人的黑羯精锐，说白了——就是等死。

周疤子此刻彻底没了之前的嚣张。

他在边关混了十几年，欺压新兵、克扣军饷是一把好手，真碰上羯骑，怂得比谁都快。他太清楚黑羯的恐怖，根本不是他们这群残兵能挡的。

“都给我上墙守着！”周疤子强行压着颤抖的嗓子吼道，“谁敢乱跑跳墙，战后军法处置！”

话虽这么说，所有人心里都明镜似的。

真破堡了，大家全死，哪来的战后。

一众小兵哆哆嗦嗦上墙，脸色惨白，眼神里全是绝望。

陈石头紧紧跟着苏烬，吓得浑身发抖，声音都带着哭腔：

“苏烬，咱们这次真完了。”

“半个月前青石堡你知道吧？五十个正规守军，城墙比咱们厚一倍，武器粮草都齐全。结果黑羯一冲，一个时辰不到，全堡屠干净，一个活口没留。”

“现在大雪封路，雁朔关主力都是步兵，离这儿几百里。雪地里赶路太慢了，最快也要大半天才能到。”

“大半天啊，足够羯人杀咱们好几遍了！”

黑石堡就是个弃子死地。

前不着村后不着店，无援无救，朝廷早就把这破地方忘了。死几个小兵，名册划个名字，连水花都溅不起来。

换以前的苏烬，早就吓傻了。

但现在这身体里，是现代野战老兵的灵魂。

胸口断骨剧痛、风寒发烧、头晕目眩、嘴角渗血，伤势重得吓人。可苏烬从头到尾，心态稳得离谱。

他太懂绝境了。

越是必死的局，越不能慌，一慌就真没了。

“别乱。”苏烬低声道，“现在跑，死得最快。稳住阵型守住缺口，才有机会撑到援军。”

陈石头愣愣点头，莫名觉得现在的苏烬特别靠谱。

两人快步登上土墙。

风雪狂暴，漫天雪白，视野极差，放眼望去一片白茫茫，根本看不清远处动静。

但苏烬知道——

看不见敌人，才是最危险的时候。

黑石堡墙又矮又破，多处坍塌，朽木挡泥糊弄了事，根本算不上防御。二十三个残兵站在墙上，握武器的手全在抖，军心已经濒临溃散。

堡主刘屯将，四十多岁，在边关熬了五年。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Everyone in the northern border army is afraid of the Black Jerome cavalry.

This group of grassland barbarians grew up on horses. They were skilled in bow and horse, fierce and bloodthirsty, and they went south to burn, kill and plunder all the year round.

They neither cultivated nor farmed the land, and made a living by raiding the borders. Wherever they passed, no chickens or dogs were left behind, and corpses littered the fields.

The Black Capricorn cavalry are extremely mobile. If they win, they will charge into the formation and massacre. If they cannot win, they will ride roundabouts, fly kites, and use bows and arrows to kill the infantry alive.

Even Dayong's regular army often suffers heavy losses, let alone a shabby border fort like Blackstone Fort that no one cares about and no one cares about.

The private fight between Su Jin and Zhou Scarzi was immediately canceled when the enemy's attack horn sounded.

Who dares to fight among themselves when their lives are almost gone?

The Black Stone Garrison had fifty men, and the officials protected each other and had no pay. Now there are only twenty-three old and weak soldiers left.

Either they are old, have old injuries, or they are weak recruits.

The weapons are even more terrible.

The knives were rusty knives, the spears were broken spears, the shields were cracked, and several of them had only wooden sticks in their hands that even the iron guy couldn't touch.

With this configuration, facing thirty heavily armed Black Capricorn elites who kill people all year round, to put it bluntly - they are just waiting to die.

Zhou Scarzi now completely lost his previous arrogance.

He has been working at the border for more than ten years, and he is very good at bullying new recruits and deducting military pay. If he really meets Jie Qi, he will be intimidated faster than anyone else.He knew very well that the terror of Black Jie was beyond what they, the remnants of the army, could stop.

"Get up on the wall and guard me!" Zhou Scarzi shouted, suppressing his trembling voice, "Whoever dares to run around and jump over the wall will be dealt with by military law after the war!"

Having said that, everyone has a clear mind.

The fort was really destroyed and everyone died. How could there be a war?

A group of soldiers trembled and climbed up the wall, their faces pale and their eyes full of despair.

Chen Shitou followed Su Jin closely, trembling with fear, and his voice sounded like crying:

"Su Jin, we are really finished this time."

"Half a month ago, you know the Bluestone Castle? There were fifty regular defenders. The city wall was twice as thick as ours, and they had all the weapons and supplies. But Black Jie rushed in, and in less than an hour, the entire castle was slaughtered, leaving no one alive."

"The road is now blocked by heavy snow, and the main force at Yanshuoguan is infantry, which is hundreds of miles away from here. Traveling in the snow is too slow, and it will take more than half a day to get there at the fastest."

"Most of the day is enough for the Jie people to kill us several times!"

Blackstone Castle is a place where abandoned children die.

With no village, no shop, and no help or rescue, the imperial court had long forgotten about this poor place.A few soldiers were killed, and names were drawn on the roster, without even splashing.

The previous Su Jin would have been scared to death.

But now in this body is the soul of a modern field veteran.

Severe pain from a broken bone in his chest, cold and fever, dizziness, and blood oozing from the corners of his mouth. The injuries were frighteningly serious.But Su Jin's mentality was ridiculously stable from beginning to end.

He understands desperate situations all too well.

The more certain the situation is, the less you should panic. Once you panic, it will be over.

"Don't mess up." Su Jin whispered, "Run now, you will die the fastest. Only by holding on to your formation and guarding the gap will you have a chance to get reinforcements."

Chen Shitou nodded blankly, inexplicably feeling that Su Jin was particularly reliable now.

The two quickly climbed up the earth wall.

The wind and snow were violent, the sky was white, and the field of vision was extremely poor. Looking around, it was completely white, and it was impossible to see anything in the distance.

But Su Jin knew——

The most dangerous time is when you can't see the enemy.

The Black Stone Fortress wall is short and broken, with many places collapsed, and the rotten wood blocking the wall is muddy. It cannot be considered a defense at all.Twenty-three remnant soldiers stood on the wall, the hands holding weapons were shaking, and the morale of the army was on the verge of collapse.

The lord of the fort, General Liu Tun, was in his forties and had been at the border for five years.
